item.title: FTTx Feasibility Design
item.description:
Smarter FTTx Feasibility with Automated Route Design

Planning an FTTx network has always been a challenge. Between mapping every address that needs service, evaluating candidate cable paths, and estimating costs, network planners often spend weeks just pulling the data together—before they can even begin analyzing feasibility.

That’s where our web application changes the game.

From Raw Data to Feasibility in Minutes

Our cloud-based SaaS tool is designed to take the complexity out of early-stage FTTx planning. Instead of relying on spreadsheets, manual drawings, or scattered data sources, planners can now generate optimized route designs directly in their browser.

item.title: Network Feasibility Analysis
item.description:
Build Confidence in Your Network Investment

Considering a new network deployment?
A thorough feasibility analysis is the smartest way to de-risk your project before major capital is committed. By identifying key cost drivers, sensitivities, and dependencies up front, you can make decisions with clarity and confidence.

At Pozibl, we bring years of experience developing specialized software tools for feasibility studies. Our approach delivers objective, defensible cost estimates that help stakeholders and investors trust your project plan.
